subject: Caravel capacity review: deck + runbook — scheduling confirmation
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rudd <alex@caravel.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@caravel.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Caravel capacity review: deck + runbook — scheduling request

Hi Alex / Samira,

Thanks again for the quick product walkthrough last week. As discussed on the call, we'd like to schedule a focused technical deep-dive on Dedicated GPU capacity so we can walk through: pool sizing assumptions, autoscaling behavior under mixed workloads, and isolation/failure modes.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- Quick context & workload profile (you)
- Pool sizing math and headroom targets (us)
- Autoscale triggers, burst policies, and fallback rules
- Isolation, eviction scenarios, and multi-tenant guardrails
- Next steps / open actions

Please share 2x 45-minute slots that work for your engineering & infra leads next week. I’ve attached our draft runbook + sizing template and a short slide deck to save time.

Attach: presentation-dedicated-capacity.pptx, redwood-runbook-v1.pdf, pool-sizing-template.xlsx

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

From: Alex Rudd <alex@caravel.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@caravel.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Caravel capacity review: deck + runbook — scheduling request

Thanks Priya — this looks great. We can do Tuesday 2027-03-16 09:30–10:15 PT or Wednesday 2027-03-17 14:00–14:45 PT. Our infra lead (Samira) will join both slots but Samira asked for at least one follow-up with procurement on quotas.

Folks on our side: Alex Rudd (Platform Lead), Samira Khan (Infra). Please pick a slot and we’ll confirm.

Alex
Alex Rudd
Head of Platform, Caravel AI
alex@caravel.ai

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rudd <alex@caravel.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@caravel.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Caravel capacity review: deck + runbook — scheduling request

Alex — thanks. Let’s lock Wednesday 2027-03-17 14:00–14:45 PT. I’ve booked the slot on the Redwood calendar (link below) and attached an updated runbook with a short pre-read called "runbook-v1.pdf" — we highlighted the autoscale knobs that we’ll demo.

Attendees (Redwood): Priya Natarajan (SE), Karthik Iyer (Infra Architect), Marissa Cole (Capacity PM)
Attendees (Caravel): Alex Rudd (Platform Lead), Samira Khan (Infra)

Action items before the session:
- Caravel: export a 2-week tail of your production traffic patterns (token/s and seq distribution) — Samira will share an anonymized CSV if possible.
- Redwood: we’ll pre-populate the pool-sizing-template.xlsx with two scenarios (steady vs burst) and include recommended headroom.

Attach: redwood-runbook-v1.pdf, pool-sizing-template.xlsx
Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/6e8f3b2c

See you then — sending a concise invite to make sure procurement is looped.

Thanks,
Priya

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rudd <alex@caravel.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@caravel.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Caravel capacity review: deck + runbook — scheduling request

Quick note — added one ask for the agenda: please allocate 8–10 minutes near the end to walk isolation & eviction scenarios (we should run a quick tabletop — what happens to long-running KV cache sessions during slab reclamation?). Also, marissa and I will bring a short backup slide showing network egress and placement constraints for dedicated pools.

If Caravel has any specific SLAs or tenant isolation requirements, drop them into the shared Drive folder and we’ll call them out in the runbook.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infra Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rudd <alex@caravel.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@caravel.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Caravel capacity review: deck + runbook — scheduling request

All — perfect. I updated the agenda to include the isolation tabletop and attached the final slide deck. I also invited Caravel procurement to join the first 10 minutes to outline quota and procurement path.

Quick logistics:
- Final calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/6e8f3b2c (accepted)
- Pre-reads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF_runbook
- DocuSign (procurement quote will follow after the session): https://docusign.com/ABC-quote-link

We’ll run the demo from a pre-provisioned sandbox pool so you can see autoscale and eviction behavior without hitting prod. If anyone needs the meeting in a different timezone window, ping me and we’ll rebook.

Thanks everyone — looking forward.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
